question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, and if so should it be default-compatible or opt-in?
rationale: The requested behavior is source-verifiably missing and feasible inside the plugin, but it changes official plugin retrieval semantics, config surface, persistent index lifecycle, and fallback policy.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add an official memory-lancedb hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep advanced retrieval external
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb vector-only and point advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank users to an external or ClawHub package.

options.title: Declare vector-only by design
options.body: Close the feature direction after documenting that memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval while memory-lancedb remains a vector backend.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add an official memory-lancedb hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback, docs, and regression tests.
